data.min_gpa: outstanding and highly successful academic record
data.other_hard: most recent degree must not be older than four years and three months at time of application; applications may be submitted no earlier than the final semester of a master's programme or equivalent; funding must start within the period in the award letter; no parallel taught degree or professional training during the scholarship; part-time doctoral degrees cannot be funded; doctoral studies parallel to a medical degree are not eligible; another funder's doctoral funding must be terminated before start
data.evidence_sentence: The doctoral candidate has been accepted for a doctoral programme at a German university where the thesis will also be submitted; nationality is irrelevant.
data.notes: No specific application deadlines are given; calls are published about eight months before each selection meeting, so the current call dates must be checked on the site. Previous Studienstiftung membership is not required. The GPA-type requirement is a pre-selection eligibility criterion described only verbally.
